name: Standard Blade
description: A plain combat blade for those who fight close. Reliable, with a good chance to crit.

name: Standard Pistol
description: A light sidearm. Quick and accurate, but it does not hit hard.

name: Standard SMG
description: A rapid-fire submachine gun, handy for fast fighters.

name: Standard Rifle
description: A dependable rifle that keeps its user out of the thick of things.

name: Standard Shotgun
description: Hits hard at close range, at a small cost in speed.

name: Standard Precision Rifle
description: A long-barrelled rifle built for single, well-aimed shots with a high crit chance.

name: Standard Heavy Weapon
description: A heavy weapon: the most damage in its class, and the slowest to swing.

name: Standard Emitter
description: An emitter that turns corporate tech into a weapon, favoured by specialists and support units.

name: Standard Injector
description: An injector rig that doubles as a weapon; it also makes its wearer sturdier.

name: Light Vest
description: A light vest: some protection with no cost in speed.

name: Medium Harness
description: A medium harness: better protection, with a slight cost in speed.

name: Heavy Plate
description: A heavy plate: the best protection in the armory, but it slows its wearer.

name: Light Greaves
description: Light greaves: modest protection and no cost in speed.

name: Medium Greaves
description: Medium greaves: solid protection with a slight cost in speed.

name: Heavy Greaves
description: Heavy greaves: strong protection, and they slow their wearer down.

name: Bloom Fang
description: A blade grown from Bloom tissue. It cuts deep and its victims keep [[statuses:bleed|bleeding]].

name: Whisper Coil
description: A coil salvaged from an anomaly. Hold it and you hear orders no one gave: one extra Command Point each fight.

name: Grafted Plate
description: Armor with living tissue grafted in. It is heavy, and it slowly heals its wearer.
